title: Scholia v0.7 proposed Map/Event/Task semantic conformance suite
description: Self-describing positive and negative fixtures for the proposed additive Map/Event/Task contract (SCHOLIA_v0.7_SPEC.md). Each case declares its input format, payload, and — for negative cases — the expected failure phase (parse: the input never becomes an atom; validate: a constructed atom or trace is rejected) plus the proposed rule code and a required diagnostic subset. Positive cases declare round-trip (XML→JSON→YAML→XML semantic equality, IDs/canonical IDs/typed values retained, children empty) and repeated-canonical-JSON stability expectations, and optionally a canonical-identity relation between named atoms. Implementations claiming the proposed contract execute every case with zero skips; case counts are pinned in coverage and may not shrink silently. Nothing in this suite executes work: parsing or validating a Task never starts one, and opaque external/runtime correlators are never dereferenced.

case_fields.category: positive (must pass) or negative (must fail as declared).
case_fields.kinds: New kinds exercised by the case.
case_fields.format: xml | json | yaml (payload is document text) or dict (payload is the in-memory mapping input).
case_fields.payload_b: Optional second document for cross-trace identity probes.
case_fields.profile: Optional explicit grammar profile the case is evaluated under.
case_fields.coverage: Optional structured annotation of field→target-kind pairs the case covers.
case_fields.identity: Optional canonical-identity expectation: relation equal|distinct over atoms (same trace) or cross_trace_atom (payload vs payload_b).
case_fields.expects: outcome pass|fail; negative cases add phase (parse|validate), rule, diagnostic_must_mention; positive cases add roundtrip and canonical_json_stable.

unknown_kind.contract: closed-set atom catalog; unknown kinds never parse.

semantic_unknown_field.contract: closed per-kind field sets across XML/JSON/YAML/dict input.

semantic_children_empty.contract: new kinds carry no nested child atoms.

semantic_operators_list.contract: operators is a list of strings; no coercion.

map_entries_shape.contract: entries is a real mapping with unique string keys; embedded-JSON and document duplicate keys are rejected while decoding.

semantic_id_shape.contract: required kind-prefixed trace-local ID with [A-Za-z0-9_]+ suffix.

semantic_id_unique.contract: no ID collision involving a new atom anywhere in the trace, including Steps and legacy atoms.

map_entries_typed.contract: homogeneous values matching value_type; empty keys, bool-as-integer, out-of-range integers, floats, nulls, arrays, nested objects, and mixed types rejected.

map_ref_resolves.contract: atom_ref values resolve to a declared non-Step atom other than the Map itself.

event_required_fields.contract: source, occurrence_id, event_type, and a nonempty body are required.

event_timestamp_shape.contract: RFC3339 with explicit timezone; impossible date/time rejected; excluded from canonical identity.

event_occurrence_unique.contract: (source, occurrence_id) unique per trace, even for identical bodies.

task_required_fields.contract: status and a nonempty body are required.

task_status_enum.contract: status is exactly open|satisfied|unsatisfied|withdrawn; runtime lifecycle states rejected.

semantic_ref_target_kind.contract: declared reference fields resolve to their permitted target kinds; dangling or wrong-kind targets rejected.

canonical_id_well_formed.contract: unchanged: claimed canonical_id must be well-formed and match the recomputed value.

grammar_profile_unsupported.contract: new kinds under an explicit legacy 0.6.2 profile, and unknown profiles, produce a structured unsupported-version diagnostic.

goal_declared.contract: A semantic Task does not close a required Goal; existing explicit Finding/Concluding closure rules remain authoritative.

action_recorded.contract: A semantic Task does not supply the explicit recorded result required for an Action.

required_assertions: Deny filesystem writes, subprocess creation and network calls during construction, parsing, validation, canonical hashing and serialization for each new kind.
Load imports/fixtures before denial hooks. Do not replace the implementation or validator. Registry persistence is deliberately outside these pure-operation tests.
Compare deep snapshots before/after serialization, including atom and Map entries/operators/children container identities.
Missing canonical_id is computed only on a validated copy; caller claim remains missing. Explicit mismatched claim is never repaired even on serialization failure.
Retain typed values and opaque strings through repeated round trips.
Force the real truncated hash seam for two different unpatched structural payloads; do not patch comparison or substitute the runtime.
Require an explicit collision diagnostic and unchanged first registry record, indexes and persisted bytes after refusal.
Reload disk state and verify the original record remains intact.
Equal full canonical payloads with distinct local references may share identity; registration is idempotent, not a structural collision.
Preserve first record and verify disk reload.
Event same-trace occurrence-pair duplicate rules still apply; separate-trace registry controls do not waive them.
Event timestamp-only provenance difference retains canonical identity and is not a structural collision.
Preserve intended provenance without replacing first structural content.
Existing legacy provenance behavior remains unchanged; no global hash/provenance rule change.
Pass true Python nonstring keys before serialization can stringify them; reject malformed mapping shape at parse.
Reject arbitrary objects without coercion; nonfinite values in legal in-memory/YAML objects remain validate-phase typed failures.
Directly constructed malformed new atoms fail validation with structural constraints, not just parser checks.
Compute actual target canonical IDs and use them as exact references, including forward references.
Exercise all 35 permitted Map target kinds plus all 13 named typed field/target pairs, each canonical-prior and canonical-forward. Use a distinct target Map, never self-reference.
Preserve wrong-kind/dangling/self/Step rejection and never resolve opaque correlators.
Structural field/content changes change canonical identity; insertion-order independence and timestamp exclusion remain unchanged.
Preserve claimed canonical IDs through every decoder and reject mismatches without silent repair.
URL-like and ID-like external_ref/runtime_ref remain opaque under denial hooks.
Neither Event creation nor satisfied Task validation sends notifications, starts work, authorizes runtime transitions or replaces required legacy closure/results.
Use real separately installed 0.7.2 with artifact hash/import-origin evidence.
Execute preserved legacy corpus and report real unknown-kind errors on new kinds without patching old artifact.
Keep old parser errors distinct from new structured profile rejection; never silently rewrite kinds.
Separate source/wheel/sdist-installed environments execute exact full corpus and runtime obligations with no required skips.
Bind source/spec SHAs, corpus/artifact hashes, versions/catalog/fields, import origins, commands, exact node IDs and counts.
Installed artifacts run outside source roots; stale/missing corpus, import-origin leakage and generated drift fail.

<Step id="S_01">
  <Goal id="G_01" scope="trace">Ship the fixture change.</Goal>
  <Action id="A_01">Edited the fixture.<Finding id="F_01">The fixture compiles.</Finding></Action>

  <Event id="Event_01" source="worker" occurrence_id="occ-1" event_type="unit.recorded" for_task="Task_01">The occurrence was recorded.</Event>
  <Concluding id="C_01" for_goal="G_01" status="met">REFER:F_01 closes the goal.</Concluding>
</Step>

cases.description: Duplicate keys inside the embedded JSON attribute are rejected while decoding, before information is destroyed.
A full-trace JSON loader detects duplicate mapping keys in the document text before they are silently overwritten.
JSON/YAML must carry entries as an actual mapping; a JSON-encoded string is rejected.
A nonstring entry key (YAML integer key) is rejected.

cases.description: An empty string key is rejected.
Mixed value types under one declared value_type are rejected.
bool is not an integer: true under value_type=integer is rejected.
An integer beyond +(2^53−1) is outside the interoperable exact range.
Float values are rejected under every value_type.
Null values are rejected under every value_type.
Array values are rejected under every value_type.
Nested object values are rejected under every value_type.
An atom_ref value that resolves to no declared atom is rejected.
A Map must not refer to itself.
An atom_ref value resolving to a Step is rejected (any kind except Step).
Identical prose with distinct occurrence_id values yields two valid Events with distinct canonical IDs.
